title: FrameShift tool request
description: One brokered capability execution. The fields are those #24 lists. Every one of them is something a human must be able to see before approving, which is why they are required rather than inferred at execution time.

arguments.description: Validated against the capability's own input schema, not this one.

purpose.description: Why this is being run, in terms a human approving it can weigh.

data_classes.description: What leaves the session. An approver is agreeing to this, not only to the operation.

idempotency_key.description: A retry reuses this. Reuse with a different payload is rejected.

destination.description: Where the data goes, when it goes anywhere.
